infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: BrewTracker uses your location for clock-in, service visits, and live route tracking.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: BrewTracker uses your location while you are clocked in so dispatch can see your current route position.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow BrewTracker to use your location for clock-in and service visits.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow BrewTracker to track your route while you are clocked in.
